subject: Renewal proposal: Premium SLA, capacity sequencing, and term alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lara Gomez <lara@quokka.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal proposal: premium SLA, capacity sequencing, and term alignment

Hi Lara —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our renewal cadence, attached is a draft that aligns Quokka's usage pattern with a two-year term and introduces the premium SLA bundle we discussed (faster response targets + incident credits). Highlights: 

- Dedicated capacity reservation for Q1–Q2 peak windows with predictable burst headroom
- Latency SLOs: P50/P90/P99 bands by endpoint and agreement on measurement windows (attached spreadsheet)
- Option for quarterly pilot of a higher throughput instance for A/B traffic shaping
- One-time onboarding credit to cover migration and playbook creation (applied to invoice 1)

I've attached the draft contract, the SLA latency bands spreadsheet, and a suggested mutual action plan. Can you confirm whether procurement needs the full contract package (including SOC 2 artifacts) for legal review, or would a redlineable PDF be enough to start?

If this looks directionally accurate I'll loop in our renewal ops lead (Evelyn) and start a short canary for the capacity reservation timing. Proposed next step: review with procurement + signoff on the M.A.P. by Dec 10 to lock Q1 capacity.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: QK-Renewal-2027-draft.pdf (PDF), SLA-latency-bands.xlsx (XLSX), mutual-action-plan.docx (DOCX)
From: Lara Gomez <lara@quokka.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 13:27:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: premium SLA, capacity sequencing, and term alignment

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear doc. A few items from our side before we escalate to procurement: 

1) Can you confirm the P99 measurement window and whether synthetic checks will be included in reporting? Our SRE team is sensitive to metrics that mix synthetic and production traffic.
2) The dedicated capacity reservation looks right, but we need clarity on the enforcement model and how burst billing behaves if we exceed reserved QPS.
3) Is there a short-term option to trial a higher-throughput instance for two weeks in late January to validate LLM tail latency under our workload?

Procurement is cc'ing procurement@quokka.ai here. If you can answer the above and provide a redlineable contract PDF, I'll get legal and procurement to engage. We like the idea of the onboarding credit — thanks for that.

Best,
Lara Gomez
Head of Platform Engineering, Quokka AI
lara@quokka.ai

> Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our renewal cadence, attached is a draft that aligns Quokka's usage pattern...
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal proposal – negotiation guardrails and concessions

Marissa —

Quick internal note before we reply to Lara: recommended guardrails and concessions to keep the ACV intact without opening discounts too wide. My suggestions: 

- Confirm P99 measured on production only (no synthetic). If Quokka asks for synthetics, make them opt-in to visibility but leave SLO reporting on prod.
- For burst enforcement: allow 25% burst above reserved QPS for free, beyond that bill at 1.25x the unit rate for that month (we've used this mechanism successfully).
- Offer the two-week higher-throughput trial in late Jan as an included pilot (no extra charge) provided we get signoff on the M.A.P. and a simple usage cap.
- As a one-off, provide the onboarding credit (covers up to $25k of professional services) and a single month credit on the monthly invoice if they commit to a 24-month term.

If you want to be more aggressive we can offer a 6% price concession but let's keep that as a last resort and run it past Karthik and finance.

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: negotiation-guardrails-notes.txt (TXT)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lara Gomez <lara@quokka.ai>, procurement@quokka.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: premium SLA, capacity sequencing, and term alignment

Lara / Quokka procurement —

Thanks — answering inline and attaching a redlineable PDF now. Short answers up front: 

1) P99 measurement: production-only. We'll exclude synthetic checks from the SLA measurement window; we can surface synthetic alongside production in the Console for diagnostics but it will not affect credit calculations. See section 4.2 in the attached redline.

2) Burst enforcement: 25% free burst over reserved baseline; anything beyond billed at 1.25x unit rates for the overage month. We'll include automatic alerts at 85% of reserved QPS so your SREs have lead time.

3) Trial: we'll schedule a two-week trial of the higher-throughput instance for Jan 17–31. We'll provision a pilot pool, enable KV prefix caching for your test subset, and assign a dedicated ops contact. No charge for the pilot if the M.A.P. is signed by Dec 10.

Next steps: 
- I've uploaded a redlineable PDF to the DocuSign link below for your legal review. If procurement wants edits, please share a single PDF with comments to streamline the review cycle.
- Ben / Karthik — please confirm the pricing line items reflect the 24-month commitment with the one-month invoice credit. Evelyn, can you confirm the onboarding schedule and the ops contact for the pilot?

DocuSign (redlineable): https://www.docusign.com/seed/1234-QUOKKA-SLA
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/QK-2026-1142

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: QK-Renewal-2027-draft-redline.pdf (PDF)
From: Lara Gomez <lara@quokka.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@quokka.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 16:43:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: premium SLA, capacity sequencing, and term alignment

Marissa / team —

Appreciate the clear answers and the redlineable PDF. Procurement will start internal review today. We agree to the production-only P99 measurement and the 25% free burst band. The Jan 17–31 pilot window works for us — procurement and SRE will coordinate the usage cap details in a follow-up.

We will route the redline to legal; next milestone is M.A.P. signoff and DocuSign by Dec 10 to lock the Q1 capacity. I'll confirm procurement's redline cadence by EOD tomorrow.

Lara
Head of Platform Engineering, Quokka AI
